statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2), KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.FromLP s x) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.FromLP s x) = ‖x‖
proof:
intro s x
have hx : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖x k‖^2) := by
  simpa using (lp.memℓp x).summable (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)
have he : (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖KdVPlan.FromLP s x k‖^2) = (fun k => ‖x k‖^2) := by
  funext k
  exact (yui_aux_0002 T gamma R s x k).2.1
refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
· unfold KdVPlan.MemH
  rw [he]
  exact hx
· unfold KdVPlan.hn
  rw [he, lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal)]
  simp [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
